heading: Things I've *built.*
intro: Five production platforms for a regulator, a bank, retail and payments, and one open-source MCP server. Each shows the need, what I built and the result.
note: Client code is confidential. The MCP server is public on [GitHub]({github}), and I'm glad to walk through the architecture of the rest in an interview.

items.label: Avanade Asia · Generative AI
items.title: PathFin.ai
items.need: Signed-in users of a financial AI platform needed secure, relevant answers to financial knowledge questions.
items.built: I architected the platform end to end: a RAG chatbot on OpenAI embeddings and a pgvector store, a React front end, and a serverless AWS backend in Python and Django.
highlights: RAG chatbot behind JWT and OTP sign-in
Google Sheets sync cut update time ~80%

items.label: Avanade Asia · Digital currency
items.title: CBDC Platform
items.need: Financial institutions had to request a central bank digital currency and the central bank's operations team had to issue it, with every step controlled and traceable.
items.built: Two separate portals on React and NestJS, upgradeable ERC-20 smart contracts in Solidity, and dedicated Web3 nodes on a private Hyperledger Besu network, proven on simulated transactions.
highlights: Mint and burn with zero-downtime upgrades
OpenID SSO and Active Directory roles
Private Blockscout explorer for audit trails

items.label: Toshiba Global Commerce · Technical Lead
items.title: SAP Integration & Fuel Management
items.need: Fuel and point-of-sale systems had to exchange data with SAP in both directions, reliably and at volume.
items.built: As Technical Lead I took it from proof of concept to production: six Java and Spring Boot microservices for sync, XML processing and transactions, plus a React operations portal.

items.label: OCBC Bank · Banking
items.title: Corporate Loan Approval
items.need: OCBC needed an enterprise platform to run approvals for large corporate loans.
items.built: I owned it from requirements analysis to production rollout in six months: two Spring Boot microservices for the approval logic, two independently deployable React micro-frontends, and Kafka events to downstream banking systems.

items.label: Visa Worldwide · Payments
items.title: Payments Platform
items.need: A global payment platform has to stay stable at peak load in every region.
items.built: I designed microservices and GraphQL APIs on Spring Boot and AWS, automated releases across Jenkins and Azure DevOps, and added AI-assisted analytics to operational monitoring.

items.label: Open source · AI agents
items.title: Payment Intelligence MCP Server
items.need: An AI agent investigating a payment needs access to payment data that is permissioned and audited.
items.built: An MCP server in Python that gives agents four tools: payment lookup, customer profile, transaction search and rule-based risk scoring. It runs on sample data, so anyone can try it.
highlights: JSON audit logs that mask sensitive fields
Decline-code policy as an MCP resource
Runs over stdio or SSE, in Docker
